issues.where: foreground cliff rock and snow across the left and center crops (also visible in set-A-07.png and set-A-09.png)
issues.what: a prominent rectangular mesh/texel grid pattern covers blurry, stretched low-resolution rock and snow textures where the camera is close
issues.fix: rebuild the close-up cliff with high-resolution rock geometry, crisp displacement, and unstretched close-range textures with no visible grid

issues.where: snow and ice ground on the right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%, also visible in set-A-04.png)
issues.what: a sharp, straight horizontal seam slices across the ground and the surface texture is heavily stretched horizontally with a smooth, waxy look
issues.fix: remove the horizontal seam and replace the stretched plane with detailed snow and ice micro-relief

issues.where: torn-open torso cavity of the carcass (also in set-A-06.png left crop)
issues.what: the interior cavity is crushed pure black with smooth, uniform cone-like ribs and disconnected fur cards floating along the dark edge
issues.fix: lift the pure black with subtle bounce light and wet tissue depth, give the ribs irregular organic shape, and root the fur cleanly into the hide

issues.where: left end of the carcass in the bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%, also in set-A-04.png)
issues.what: the dark tendrils read as rigid, glossy CG cylinders with visible polygonal facets emerging from a faceted plastic-looking cap
issues.fix: increase geometry resolution to remove facets and give the organic structures natural variation, matte-wet shading, and frost or snow buildup

issues.where: distant hooked peaks in the right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%, also in set-A-01.png)
issues.what: the upper spires are flat, uniform grey-purple silhouette cutouts with hard edges and no internal shading or volumetric air transition
issues.fix: shade the distant spires with real geological relief and gradual depth-based atmospheric haze instead of flat cutout silhouettes

issues.where: lightning bolt and surrounding clouds and spire in the upper right
issues.what: the bright lightning bolt casts almost no illumination onto the surrounding storm clouds, the struck peak, or the foreground snow, and lacks realistic bloom
issues.fix: add volumetric cloud illumination, natural bloom around the bolt, and bounce light across the struck spire and nearby ridges

issues.where: snowy ridge in the lower left (around x 25%, y 77%)
issues.what: a small upright human figure stands at the end of a trail of footprints in the snow
issues.fix: remove the person and the footprints from the snowy ridge

issues.where: streaming veined membranes in the right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%, also in set-A-07.png)
issues.what: the membranes read as zero-thickness flat CG planes with jagged aliased edges and flat cool shading that ignores the warm sunset light behind them
issues.fix: give the membranes physical thickness, warm translucent backlighting from the horizon, and clean anti-aliased edges

issues.where: steep rock face of the main spire in the left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%, also in set-A-05.png top-right crop)
issues.what: the rock and snow texture is heavily stretched and smeared vertically along the cliff face, reading as soft painted clay rather than fractured rock
issues.fix: use triplanar mapping and higher-resolution cliff displacement so steep slopes hold crisp rock strata without stretching

issues.where: carcass paws, claws, and snow contact along the body
issues.what: the paws look smooth and clay-like with rigid cone claws, painted-on white snow caps, and weak contact shadows where the carcass rests on the snow
issues.fix: add fine anatomical texture, real snow accumulation in fur crevices, and grounded contact occlusion beneath the body

issues.where: dark bulbous pods on the ridge in the top-right crop (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%, also in set-A-07.png)
issues.what: the pods look like smooth, glossy bump-mapped CG blobs sitting awkwardly on a blurry rock edge with no frost or snow integration
issues.fix: add finer organic detail, frost and windblown snow buildup, and physical anchoring into the rock surface

issues.where: low cloud deck in the bottom-right crop (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%, also in set-A-01.png)
issues.what: the clouds read as flat, sharp-edged 2D layered cards sitting in uniform grey-blue fog with no volumetric depth or light
issues.fix: replace the flat cloud layers with volumetric clouds that catch ambient sky light and soften naturally into the distance

issues.where: distant right spire and left sky (bottom-left and top-left crops, also in set-A-04.png)
issues.what: the distant peak is flattened into a uniform grey-purple tint with a hard cutout edge, while the left sky consists of smooth, featureless horizontal streaks
issues.fix: preserve subtle lighting and form detail through atmospheric haze on distant peaks and add realistic volumetric cloud structure to the sky

issues.where: cave mouth at the base of the main spire (center)
issues.what: the cave opening is a flat near-black void with a soft fuzzy border and no interior rock structure or ambient light falloff
issues.fix: model recessed rock walls, snow drift at the entrance, and gradual ambient occlusion into the cave interior
